text: Renouncing Self is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Cathedral's bell tower in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Bozé and Cross during the morning. This Heart-to-Heart is unusual in that one of the options will advance the game's day/night clock by 9 hours depending on the path taken, though the dialogue itself implies 30 hours (6 hours + 1 day).
|-|Normal = |-|Worn = |-|Advanced = Reginal Yiis are Light Wear Head armor in and . They are manufactured by Orphean Technologies and are part of the Reginal armor range.

Reverse Millepod Fins are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Millepods, or for 198 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are one of the required components of X, XV, and XX Ultrafauna Slayer and Slayer.ULTRAFAUNA augments.
Rival Partners is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts two Wrothians, Gi Ziorde and Gi Ziordo. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Two Warriors.

Riv Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Grenada Galactic Group Knife. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Wreckage category of the Oblivia Collectopedia. The Riv weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Riv * Iron Riv * Carbide Riv * Cermet Riv * Chrome Riv * Chromoly Riv * Cobalt Riv * Titanium Riv * Ceramic Riv * Diamond Riv

Renegade Troopers is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.13, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting three Thunderbolt Emblems. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Rise of the Giant Worm is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.14, and is unlocked if the extra Oc-serv is defeated during A Tidy Partner. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Reinvigorate is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases the amount of health that a party member has when revived.
Resistance Reducer is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that lessens the degree to which enemies resist debuffs.
Rising Energy Mist Screen is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that nullifies the debuffs and buffs from rising energy mist weather. The Skell equivalent is Weather.RISING-E-MIST-RES.
The Reverend's Journal is an important item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be obtained during A Present for Hope. It is obtained from a piece of wreckage in Cauldros' Forgotten Mining Frigates.
Resist Stagger is a ground armor Debuff resistance augment in and . It increases resistance to Stagger by 5 to 100. The Skell equivalent is Resist.STAGGER.

Reinforced Cranks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by M40-type Mechon in Mechonis Field and the Central Factory.
Reinforced Frames are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from M50-type Mechon in Mechonis Field and Central Factory. They are not available for trade.

Reinforced Jets are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Mechon in Mechonis Field and the Central Factory, but cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are fairly resilient parts that should stay strong for 100 years. Reinforced Plungers, Reinforced Thrusters, and Reinforced Cores share this description. Two are required for Best Boots.
Reinforced Plugs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Reinforced Plungers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Mechon in Mechonis Field and the Central Factory, but cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are fairly resilient parts that should stay strong for 100 years. Reinforced Jets, Reinforced Thrusters, and Reinforced Cores share this description. Two of them are required for Best Boots.

Reinforced Thrusters are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Mechon in Mechonis Field and the Central Factory, but cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are fairly resilient parts that should stay strong for 100 years. Reinforced Jets, Reinforced Plungers, and Reinforced Cores share this description. Two are needed for A Weapon Just For Me.

The Residential District (Japanese: , Kyojū-ku) is a location in . It is the southern-most of the three districts in Colony 9, and the area where many of the Homs and Nopon in Colony 9 live. Many NPCs can be found here, as well as "Watching Over Them" - a Heart-to-Heart between Reyn and Dunban.

Rhino Assault (Japanese: , Rainoasaruto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Greataxe.
Rigid Shield (Japanese: , Gachigachi shīrudo) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Tora's arts when using a Drill Shield.
Rhinons (Japanese: , Raino) are a family of enemies in the . They are large rhinoceros-like quadrupeds often used by Ignas as beasts of war.
The Residential Area (Japanese: , Teosuaure Kyojūku) of Theosoir is a Location in . It is located in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Rigitte Harbor (Japanese: , Rijite-kō) is a landmark in . It is located in the Rigitte Waters of the Leftherian Archipelago and is the first place visited in the archipelago. It is linked by a walkway to Baldotas Isle. There is one Treasure Trove and two Collection Points here. The Salvage Point, Near Rigitte Harbor, is located by the Indoline Titan Ship.

The Rhadamanthus Portal (Japanese: , Radamantisu: Entoransu) is a landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the First Low Orbit Station before the Hill Overlooking Elysium, and is accessed from Megrez, Elevator #1. There is a Treasure Trove and the Heart-to-Heart "Top of the World" here. There are no enemies here.
The Rigitte Waters (Japanese: , Rijite Kaiiki) are a level in . They are part of the Leftherian Archipelago, joined by the Cloudway to Fonsett Waters.

The Restful Waters (Japanese: , Kyūsoku no Mizuba) are a Location in . They are located on the right side of the upper level of the Gormott Province, in the middle of the tunnel connecting Outlook Knoll and Garanti Plain. This area was previously known as the Wayside Respite. There are no enemies here.

Riiks (Japanese: , Ratōru) are a family of enemies in and . They are found in Uraya and Spirit Crucible Elpys. They are cat-like burrowing creatures similar to Rodonyas. They come in green and purple varieties.

The Roadway to 7th Perimeter (Japanese: , Dai-shichi Gaikaku Renrakutsūro) is a location in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree, between Mizar, Elevator #20 and the 7th Perimeter Entrance. There are no enemies here except during World Tree Disaster.
Rhoyna is an NPC in . Rhoyna is an Urayan who can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. Rhoyna runs a shop called Vibrattio Instruments specialized in Instruments.

Remorseful Vaclav (Japanese: , Chōbatsu Butai no Vangā) is a Unique Monster in . He is an Ardainian Soldier, and can be found at level 14 in the back right cell of Solitary Block #1 of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province. After Mòrag joins the party, he is the only Ardainian Soldier on the ship that can still be battled.

Relic-Holder Tyrannor (Japanese: , Hihō no Tairanto) is an enemy in . It is a member of the Guldo family and can be found at level 57 at the 7th Division in the Land of Morytha. This enemy will spawn after the party has entered the World Tree for the first time. It drops the Mysterious Part F when defeated for the first time, needed during the quest The Riddle on the Wall, and will no longer respawn once that quest has been completed.

Relentless Arduran (Japanese: , Mōshin no Arudoran) is a quest-exclusive Unique Monster and Boss in . It is a member of the Ardun family and can be found at level 99 at Kloom Farm in the Gormott Province after supplying Pekka with a certain amount of food for his Ardun. It will respawn after checking the named tombstone. Despite all of the Ardun forms leading up to Relentless Arduran, it has the appearance of a Balgas. This may imply that Balgas are the same species as Armus and Arduns and probably a dominant male (Ardun) in . If the Ardun is killed before he grows into Relentless Arduran, then he will not spawn on that profile. In order to try again, either the player must begin a new New G

River Bunnits (Japanese: , Ribā Banitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family and can be found at level 17-23 at various locations in the Kingdom of Uraya, including Cleansing Spring, Lake Varna, Drillbore Bridge, Stone Gate Ruins. Those found in the Stomach tend to be of higher level than those in the Head. Two must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 2 Ensis Lucis Battle Skill.

Rip Volffs (Japanese: , Rippu Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 20-25 throughout the Kingdom of Uraya, such as at Sternum Arch, Minnet Terrace or Drillbore Bridge. One must be defeated during the DLC Quest A Smith's Pastime to obtain a Volff Fang (Enemy Part).

Rivarl Lexos (Japanese: , Rivaru Rekusosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lexos family, and can be found at level 39-41 at the Fonsa Myma Waters in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya during clear weather or Crystal Squall.

Ripbik Ellooks (Japanese: , Ripobikku Erūku) are enemies in . They are members of the Ellook family, and can be found at level 42-44 at the Tamie Pillars and the Sacred Grove on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. They only appear during snowfall. Three of them must be defeated during the DLC Quest Artisanal Accessories in order to get three Ellook Horns.

Rippl Medoozes (Japanese: , Rippuru Jerī) are enemies in . They are members of the Medooz family, and can be found at level 44 - 46 at Bone Road, the Underground River Lavi, Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins, and Penitents' Spring in Spirit Crucible Elpys. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Ursula's level 4 Beary Strong, and five of them to unlock Sever's level 3 "Wind Mastery".

Resurrection Symbols are accessories in . They revive all incapacitated party members when a Chain Attack is initiated. This effect will only trigger if the wearer is not incapacitated when the Chain Attack is triggered. Revived party members are able to immediately participate in the Chain Attack and have their HP restored by 30%, just like with a normal revive. HP boosting effects from accessories such as Grandarbor Ward, Spirit Tree Ward and World Tree Ward will also activate in response to this effect, however effects that trigger in response to reviving a teammate will not apply, as they are treated as self-revives.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Rigid Vests (Japanese: , Gachigachi Besuto) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's maximum HP stat by up to 300. The Infantry Vest accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect. For a similar multiplicative effect that can stack with this gear, check the Gear Vest, Abyss Vest, Jade Vest, Titanium Vest and Twin Trunks Vest accessories. Other sources of maximum HP apply before this fixed stat bonus.
Robolab Club Quarterly is a Key Item in . It can be found in a Treasure Trove on a bridge to the west of Highway 8 in the Land of Morytha. It unlocks new parts in Poppiswap.

Roast Meat Tagliatas are Meat dishes in . They can be created by Pyra at the kitchens in Tora's House and Corinne's House. She learns Vasq's Recipe for this dish from Vasq in Fonsa Myma after completing the merc mission Rainbow Shell and after Indol sinks during Chapter 9.
Rising Dragon (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Greataxe. When used, Mòrag jumps slashing her greataxe.
Rock Cleaver (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Greataxe.
Rib Grasshoppers are Insect collectibles in . They can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha. In the , Rib Grasshoppers can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Ripper Ants are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia.
Ripple Stones are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia.
Rising Dragon Rocks are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia.

Robotic Placoderms are Fish collectibles in . They can be found on the World Tree, in particular east of Mizar, Elevator #8 in the Waste Store. Four are required to unlock Elma's Level 5 "Lockpicking" Field Skill.
Revolution Flash (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Twin Rings.

The Reliquary of Tantal (Japanese: , Rukusuria Seiibutsu Hōmotsuko) is a Location in . It is located at the bottom of a staircase on the north side of the Hall of Virtue in Theoscaldia Palace, Tantal. Opening the door to the Reliquary requires Lockpicking Lv.7 and Ancient Wisdom Lv.5 Field Skills. Two Treasure Troves can be found inside the Reliquary. One contains a Nopon Doubloon and 8,900 G, the other contains an Alphabet Course+ and 2,760 G.
Righteous Guillotine (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using Twin Rings.
Reverb Blade (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Chroma Katana.

Reunion is a Heart-to-Heart in . After staying at the Coedwig Inn in Torigoth and talking to Vess, it can be viewed at the Tretl Windmill Plaza in the house where she used to live. It must be viewed to unlock Vess's level 4 "Space-Tea-Time". It features a conversation between Vess and her Driver, and the NPCs Noelle and Antis. This Heart-to-Heart can only be viewed after Vess' Blade Quest Tranquility has been completed.
Rizzente Mantles are Textile Pouch items in . They can be made by Vale using her "Weaving Lv.1" field skill at Vale's Weaving in Fonsett Village, Leftheria.

Rhombus Chips are Core Chips in and . They may only be bought from Regulus Blacksmiths in the Indoline Praetorium and Capital Weapons in the Kingdom of Torna, as well as given as one quest reward in and found in two Treasure Troves in . Rhombus Chips share their appearance with Pentagon Chips, Hexagon Chips, and Tri-Chips. __TOC__
Revl Scouts (Japanese: , Rebaria Sukauto) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 84-86 at the Old Gelgemos Gate in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Riveral Ansels (Japanese: , Riveraru Anseru) are enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 57-59 at the 7th Perimeter Skyport on the World Tree. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Vale's level 4 Tainted Palace, Azami's level 5 Decadent Finale, Nim's level 5 "Wild Familiars", Mikhail's level 4 Crow Feather, and two for Elma's level 5 "Focus".

Rhodri (Japanese: , Rohho) is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti Driver and the father of Jac. He can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, where he is involved in the quest We Meet Again. If route A of this quest is chosen, Rhodri will return to Torigoth in Gormott, where he can be found with his children Morca, Neel, and Zelen.

Rez Drivers (Japanese: , Rezzu Doraibā) are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are Drivers and Ardainian Soldiers, and can be found at level 24-28 throughout Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the story event in Chapter 4 leading to the boss battle against Lila. They can also be fought at level 51 during the Challenge Battle Titan Battleship Assault.
Rhys is an NPC in . Rhys is a Gormotti who can be found at the Goldmouth Return Port in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Roc's Core Crystal is a special Core Crystal in . It awakens Roc upon resonance and is obtained after beginning Chapter 4.
Rhidluk is an NPC in . She is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma's Entertainment District in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Rhinon Tails are Enemy Part collectibles in . They can be dropped by Rhinons, in particular from the Nomad Rhinons in the Kingdom of Uraya. Three of them are needed for the quest Fame and Family.

Grand Marshal Robalt is an NPC in . He can be found in the Battle Command of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province during Newt Recruits, and in the Throne Room in the Empire of Mor Ardain after the Blade Quest's completion.
Rix is an NPC in . Rix is a Phonex who can be found at the Aegishammer in Temperantia.
Regulus Blacksmiths is a shop in . It can be found at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium. It is run by Custavio and is specialized in Core Chips.

Revenge Tirkins (Japanese: , Ribenji Tākin) are quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 47 at the Tirkin Turf on the Upper Level of the Gormott Province during Tirkin Suppression.
Repair Torigoth's Crane is a quest in . It can be given by Natheus at the Saets Lumber Co. outside the wall to Torigoth of the Gormott Province after receiving The Case of the Crane.

The Resourceful Tirkin (Japanese: , Kichi Kisaku no Tākin) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a Tirkin fought at level 12 in front of a giant tree near Coolley Lake in Gormott Province, alongside the Infallible Tirkin, during the quest Crane Criminals.
Renle is an NPC in . Renle is an Urayan who can be found on a balcony above Torika Alley in the Kingdom of Uraya during Theory and Praxis, where the party must give him a Whelzaman Cookie.
Rheena is an NPC in . She is a Gormotti who is the owner of Keydal Accessories, the Accessory shop in the market of Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
The Right Golden Bracer is a Key Item in . It is obtained at the Fief of Forgetfulness in the Empire of Mor Ardain during Tranquility.
Rekon Aligos (Japanese: , Rekon Diburo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aligo family, and can be found at level 23-30 after Salvaging at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Rehearsal is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Vocals, Looks and Soul reach Level 9. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Earth Mastery", "Fire Mastery" and "Girls' Talk" Field Skills. It increases Ursula's fanbase by a significant amount. This mission will become unobtainable if not unlocked before the end of the quest.
Rhuban is an NPC in . Rhuban is an Urayan who can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Revolt Smash (Japanese: , Riborutosumasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Strong Smash.

Rock Bullet (Japanese: , Barettorokku, Lit. "Bullet Rock") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Rockrending Gauntlets. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Bullet Punch.

Remmiq is an NPC in . She is an Urayan girl found behind Harghalgh Inn in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. She offers the Merc Mission King of the Spring. She often talks about what her "dad" has to say on current events and the Garfont Mercenaries, but eventually reveals her dad is imaginary and that her real father died five years prior. She is always reading and will offer tips on fighting and Blades to the player.

Rhododendron (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Decimation Cannon. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Touch-Me-Not.
Road to the Capital is a quest in . It can be received from Pidede in the Port Anangham area in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Rhoab Medoozes (Japanese: , Rōbu Jerī) are three quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Medooz family, and can be found at Ysheva Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC Quest Upgrades and Tinkering. Although it is not specifically required to defeat them to complete the quest, they serve as obstacles to one of its objectives and must be fought or otherwise evaded to continue onwards. Upon completing said objective, these enemies will permanently despawn.
Reid is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian boy who can be found on Merclibay Islet in the Leftherian Archipelago. He is the reluctant Driver of Olua who attempts to give him training.
Reschas is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found at Elmos Square in the Kingdom of Tantal at night.
Ripple is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found at the Refugee Campground in the Indoline Praetorium.
Rinker Eks (Japanese: , Rinkā Ekusu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Eks family, and can be found at level 11-15 on that Ordia Great Plains in Gormott.

The Rhogulmaster (Japanese: , Rōgurumasutā) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . It is a member of the Gogol family fought at level 115 during the fourth wave of the Challenge Battle Reinventing the Gogol. This enemy drops no items.

Rimigal Parisax (Japanese: , Rimigaru Parasu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family, and can be found at level 62 during Wave 7 of Call the Exterminators, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.

Reinventing the Gogol is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Fiora's level 5 Hidden Thorn Blade Special. This challenge takes place near the Nocclia Woods in the Gormott Province.

Resistances are a game mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They alter the damage a player or enemy receives depending on the elemental classification of the attack. Resistances are given in percentage points, i.e. a resistance value of 25 in a certain element decreases all damage dealt from attacks of that element by 25%. Negative resistances can also exist, and they increases damage dealt from attacks of the associated element. There are six different categories of resistances: * Physical Resistance * Beam Resistance * Ether Resistance * Thermal Resistance * Electric Resistance * Gravity Resistance

Resurrection Points, or RP, are a game mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unique to Global Nemeses, and represents the number of times the Nemesis can reappear. Each time a player reduces the Nemesis to zero HP, its remaining RP is decremented by one and reported to a central server which relays it to all players worldwide.
